About Ironbark Supply

Ironbark Supply is an architectural ironmongery merchant supplying hand-forged hinges, latches and fixings to restoration builders across the UK. The forge was founded in Ludlow in 1994 by Marta Ionescu.

Speak to the trade counter

The workshop

Eleven smiths work from the Weir Lane forge. Made-to-order pieces are drawn, forged and finished on site, with a typical lead time of 5 to 15 working days.

Conservation work

We work to conservation-officer specification on listed buildings, and can match an existing pattern from a photograph and a rubbing.

Trade counter

The counter at Weir Lane, Ludlow, SY8 1PL is open 07:30 to 16:00 Monday to Friday.
